checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Final video 7 s with original cockpit footage preserved
must.why: Output is a 10 s black screen; the original footage is not included.
The file measures as silent, so no narration can be heard. The assistant claims it was recorded, but I can't verify that.

must.item: Speech starts within 0.5 s and 'home' ends in the last half-second
must.why: The file is 10 s long and no speech is detectable.

must.item: Calm, intelligible delivery without time-stretch artifacts
must.why: No audible sound in the file.

must.item: Original sounds absent, no music, no on-screen text
must.why: The video is black and silent, so there are no original sounds, music or captions. This is trivially met because the file has no content.

exact_text.text: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.
exact_text.read_as: No text on screen. The black frames show no captions and the audio is silent.

faults.what: The deliverable is a 10 s black video, not the 7 s cockpit clip with new narration.
The measured audio is silent (peak -54.5 dB), so the narration is not audible in the delivered file.
The narration length is 10 s and its timing is not verified against the 7 s window; the user must edit it themselves.

summary: The only output is a 10 s black, silent video, so the requested 7 s cockpit clip with replaced narration was not delivered.
